newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah firms on liquidity factor.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah firms on liquidity factor.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah firmed against the dollar in quiet early trading on Tuesday, with the focus remaining on liquidity, dealers said.
One U.S. bank dealer said the market lacked direction, trading mainly on liquidity anticipation while keeping an eye on the on-going election campaign.
"Trading is a bit lacklustre. We saw some dollar selling on expectation of a tight rupiah market, but it later reversed as the overnight rate eased," the dealer said.
"There is no fundamental view seen in the market yet."

Spot rupiah, due May 9 because of a public holiday on Thursday, was at 2,424.25/24.75 at 0245 GMT against an opening of 2,424.50/25.50. Tomorrow and today rupiah were at 2,423.25/23.75 and 2,422.50/23.00, respectively.
One Japanese bank dealer said the dollar appeared to be well supported at the 2,422.5 level on foreign orders.
Another dealer said he did not have any view but would buy on dollar dips as the downside seemed to be limited.
Dealers said the swap market was quiet and its longer-term rates were relatively stable.
Overnight swap was at 0.85/1.0 and tom/next at 1.0/1.1.
Overnight money eased to 14.0 percent from 17.0 percent.
One-month swaps were at 13.0/13.5, two at 25.50/26.25, three at 38.75/39.25 and six at 77.0/77.5 points.
Bank Indonesia kept its intervention band at 2,407/2,599 and the conversion band at 2,407/2,455 on Monday.
